notes.title: Update Released Today
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Thank you to everyone that has been in touch since launch, we really appreciate your feedback. We have released an update today to fix some of the issues you have reported, including: 

- Mouse accuracy on various game modes
- Resolution issues have been fixed
- A fix for some players experiencing a crash on game start up. (We are still looking into this issue further and hope to learn more from this update)
- We have also identified a possible fix for some crashes which involves the Steam overlay. Disabling the Steam overlay will resolve some crash issues and you can do this by accessing Steam settings in the top left, choosing ‘In Game’ and de-selecting ‘enable the steam overlay while in game’. 

If you're still having issues with the items detailed above please let us know on the pinned 'Support' post on the community forum, or drop us an email to info@ripstone.com. We are continuing to investigate audio issues and hope to fix this in an update in the near future. 

Also, we are live on Twitch now playing against the chat, so join us to try and beat us at our own game. Literally...

 Watch the Stream Now

Thanks
Ripstone

notes.title: Release Date Announcement: Today on Twitch 4pm BST
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're really excited to share that we will be announcing the release date for the Pure Chess Grandmaster Edition today live on Twitch from 4pm BST! We're going to be sharing details of the content included in this brand new version of Pure Chess and giving an exclusive first look at the game in full swing.

Join us to ask questions about all things Pure Chess and see whether our chess skills are up to scratch...

Hope to see some of you in the chat from 4pm BST (8am PST) today!

 WATCH THE STREAM
